description: Permutation-tested zone conservation: donor pocket vs acceptor-proximal second shell across GT71 paralogs
code:
exec(open("aligner.py").read())
import numpy as np, json, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict
rng=np.random.default_rng(7)
three2one={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
atoms=[]
for l in open("7XJV.pdb"):
    if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")) and l[21]=='A':
        atoms.append(dict(rec=l[:6].strip(),name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),num=int(l[22:26]),
                          xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])))
delta=40
gdd={a['name']:a['xyz'] for a in atoms if a['res']=='GDD'}
C11=gdd['C11']; gddX=np.array(list(gdd.values()))
prot=[a for a in atoms if a['rec']=='ATOM' and a['res'] in three2one]
P=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in prot])
d1=np.linalg.norm(P-C11,axis=1); d2=np.sqrt(((P[:,None,:]-gddX[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min(1)
rc=defaultdict(lambda:9e9); rg=defaultdict(lambda:9e9)
for a,x,y in zip(prot,d1,d2):
    k=a['num']+delta; rc[k]=min(rc[k],x); rg[k]=min(rg[k],y)
donor=sorted([k for k in rg if rg[k]<=4.5])
shell=sorted([k for k in rc if rc[k]<=12.0 and rg[k]>4.5])
observed=sorted(rc)
sc=json.load(open("gt71_seqs.json"))
rows=[]
for p in ["MNT4","MNN1","MNT3","MNN2","MNN5"]:
    st=stats(sc["MNT2"],sc[p]); corr=st['corr']
    mapped=[q for q in observed if q in corr]
    match=np.array([sc["MNT2"][q-1]==sc[p][corr[q]-1] for q in mapped])
    pos2i={q:i for i,q in enumerate(mapped)}
    def zone(S):
        idx=[pos2i[q] for q in S if q in pos2i]
        return match[idx], idx
    md,_=zone(donor); ms,si=zone(shell)
    perm=np.array([match[rng.choice(len(match),len(si),replace=False)].mean() for _ in range(5000)])
    rows.append(dict(paralog=p, whole_pid=round(st['pid'],1),
        donor_pid=round(100*md.mean(),1), shell_pid=round(100*ms.mean(),1),
        struct_bg_pid=round(100*match.mean(),1),
        shell_minus_bg=round(100*(ms.mean()-match.mean()),1),
        shell_perm_p=round(float((perm>=ms.mean()).mean()),4)))
t=pd.DataFrame(rows); pd.set_option("display.width",220)
print("Zone conservation vs Mnt2 (background = all structurally observed, alignable residues of the lumenal domain)")
print("shell = second shell around the transferred mannose (<=12 A of GDD C11, >4.5 A from the donor)")
print(t.to_string(index=False)); t.to_csv("zone_conservation_vs_mnt2.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5,4.8))
x=np.arange(len(t)); w=0.21
specs=[("donor_pid","#2f7d3a","donor contacts (21 res)"),
       ("shell_pid","#d9a441","mannose second shell (35 res)"),
       ("struct_bg_pid","#9aa5b1","all observed lumenal residues"),
       ("whole_pid","#4a6fa5","whole protein")]
for k,(c,col,lab) in enumerate(specs):
    ax.bar(x+(k-1.5)*w,t[c],w,color=col,label=lab)
for i,r in enumerate(t.itertuples()):
    ax.text(i-0.5*w,r.shell_pid+1.5,("p=%.3f"%r.shell_perm_p) if r.shell_perm_p>=0.001 else "p<0.001",
            ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#8a6a1f")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(t.paralog); ax.set_ylabel("% identity to Mnt2"); ax.set_ylim(0,85)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,ncol=2); ax.set_title(
 "MNT4 resembles Mnt2 in the acceptor-proximal second shell as strongly as in the donor pocket;\n"
 "MNN1, MNN2 and MNN5 resemble Mnt2 only in the donor pocket (p from 5000 permutations)",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
